subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU family and overage terms for Helios Therapeutics
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@heliostx.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliostx.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — GPU family, burst, and overage bands

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Helios was impressed with the throughput numbers. We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a multi-region deployment and need to lock in a plan by end of month to satisfy our internal procurement cadence. A few asks up front so we can move to SOW: 

- Primary request: reserve a pool with H100-class instances (prefer H100 80GB) for Q3 production traffic. Can we hold this SKU while legal finishes the SOW?
- Burst capacity: we expect short daily spikes (15–30 minutes) where we need 2–3x baseline for inference; we need a guaranteed transient burst window and clear overage rates beyond reserved capacity.
- Pricing: looking for a committed discount on the first 12 months (target ~25% off list) and a capped overage band to avoid runaway costs during trials.

Attached is our demand forecast for Q3 (Helios_Demand_Forecast_Q3.csv) and a draft SOW (SOW_Helios_v0.9.pdf). Procurement wants any reservation hold window documented (how long you can hold SKU without charging) and an exec sign-off if non-standard GPU family or special overage caps are required.

Can you confirm feasible options and whether an executive approval path is needed? Happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of ML Ops, Helios Therapeutics
emily@heliostx.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — GPU family, burst, and overage bands

Hi Emily — thanks for the detailed packet and the SOW draft. Quick answers below and I've looped in Lauren (sales lead) and Vivek (head of sales) for approval on the non-standard terms.

- H100 80GB: we can reserve H100-equivalent family for you; however, H100 80GB is a constrained SKU in several regions. We can place a 45-day reservation hold while legal finalizes SOW. After 45 days, reservation holds convert to a nominal commitment unless extended by exec approval.
- Burst: we support transient burst windows. Default overage billing is per-second at list overage rates; for cases like yours we can propose a tiered overage band (e.g., first 20% over reserved capacity billed at 75% list, next 30% at 90% list, remaining at full list) — or a capped monthly overage not to exceed X% of committed spend with an additional surcharge.
- Pricing: I can present a 20–25% committed discount model for year one, subject to a minimum committed $/month and exec sign-off for anything beyond 20% or for special SKU preferential pricing.

Next steps: Lauren — can you confirm whether deal desk is comfortable with a 45-day hold and the proposed tiered overage structure? Vivek — request your go/no-go on an H100 reservation hold and a 22% discount cap for the first 12 months (Helios is asking for 25% but procurement is flexible on commitment).

Emily — we'll aim to provide a formal approval response by EOD tomorrow after internal sign-off. If you need the reservation hold documented in a short memo for procurement, we can attach an exec stub once approved.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Forwarding Helios packet and Jasmine's summary. Deal details and ask: H100 80GB reservation hold for 45 days, transient burst needs 2–3x for short windows, request 25% off year-one list and a capped overage band.

Numbers (proposed):
- Committed reservation: $120k/month baseline (Helios estimate).
- Requested discount: 25% year one (we propose 22% cap with $100k/mo minimum).
- Proposed overage: first 20% overage at 75% list, next 30% at 90% list, remainder at 100%; alternative: hard cap at +40% monthly overage billed at 85% list.
- Reservation hold: 45 days with option to extend to 90 days with exec sign-off and a 10% deposit applied to first invoice.

Requesting Vivek's exec approval on two items:
1) Allow a reservation hold on H100 80GB SKU for 45 days and permit a single extension to 90 days if Helios provides a 10% refundable deposit.
2) Approve a discounted overage band (first 20% at 75% list, next 30% at 90% list) and cap any single-month overage cost to 40% of committed spend at 85% list.

If approved, we will issue an approval stub (exec_approval_stub.pdf) for procurement and finalize the SOW with legal.

— Lauren

Thanks for the clear summary. Approve the following with conditions — this is an exception to standard T&Cs: 

1) Reservation hold: approve 45-day hold on H100 80GB SKU. One extension to 90 days permitted only if Helios provides a 10% deposit which will be credited to the first invoice; deposit refundable if SOW is not executed within 90 days.

2) Discount: approve up to 22% off list for the first 12 months, contingent on a minimum committed spend of $100k/month. Anything beyond 22% requires director-level sign-off from me in writing.

3) Overage bands: approve tiered overage as proposed — first 20% at 75% list, next 30% at 90% list, remainder at 100% list. In addition, cap any single-month overage to 40% of committed spend billed at a blended 85% list (Redwood internal chargeback applies if exceeded).

4) Risk controls: require Helios to agree to monitoring hooks (token-level cost alerts and a pre-defined circuit-breaker that pauses burst if cost run-rate exceeds 2x forecast). Legal & Finance to add the reservation hold clause and deposit language to SOW.

5) Approval delivery: Jasmine — please prepare the exec approval stub (exec_approval_stub.pdf) with the above bullets and copy Legal along with the SOW. Lauren — update HubSpot deal DL-2027-089 with the approved concession items and estimated ARR.

This is approved as an exception to standard pricing floor. Keep this thread for audit and attach the stub and the final SOW when signed.

— Vivek
